title: Jerry Jones sounds off on Cowboys' coaching gaffes at end of Week 3 loss in Brazil: 'We made mistakes'

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Jerry Jones sounds off on Cowboys' coaching gaffes at end of Week 3 loss in Brazil: 'We made mistakes'
sources.description: Brian Schottenheimer took blame for the final-minute clock management against the Ravens, but Dallas' owner made it clear he expects the coaching staff to learn from the breakdown without making any staff changes
